symptom: A text-template parameter written as an expression, `{1} = toString($Order/Total)` (or formatDecimal(...), `$X/A + ' x'`), was stored as the AttributeRef `toString($Order/Total)`, a bogus attribute name, with check refusing only the call and operator forms (MDL-WIDGET14, which told the user MDL could not author it); and describe unwrapped a stored `toString($X/Attr)` to `$X.Attr`, which since #823 binds the attribute, so describe -> exec changed the page's rendered output.
cause: buildClientTemplateParams and buildDynamicTextV3 treated only a quoted value as an expression and sent everything else to resolveTemplateAttributePathFull; the describe unwrap reversed a toString wrap the write side no longer makes.
fix: isTemplateExpression (cmd_pages_template_attr.go): a value that is not an attribute reference is stored as the Expression; describe prints a stored expression as written; MDL-WIDGET14 retired (measured: the pre-fix binary gives CE1613 for both params of contentparam-expression-stored.mdl on a TestApp copy, the fixed one 0 errors). Plus MDL-V1-TEMPLATEATTR, the mdl 0 warning for a non-String `$name.Attr` that earlier releases wrapped in toString (option C on ako/mxcli#714).
insight: When a write side stops producing a form, remove the describe-side inverse of it in the same change: the inverse becomes a silent rewrite of anything that legitimately has that form (a hand-written toString in Studio Pro). A test that a value is 'accepted' must assert WHERE it is stored; this one parsed and executed cleanly into the wrong field.
